changelog: 🛡️ Production Security Audit & Hardening: Untracked release keystore from git, removed hardcoded signing passwords, and restricted cleartext HTTP traffic strictly to local loopback (localhost/127.0.0.1) via Network Security Config.
🔒 Manifest & Component Hardening: Unexported AndroidAppInstallReceiver, protected standalone TermuxActivity with RUN_COMMAND signature permission, and pruned unneeded CAMERA permission.
⚡ Android 14+ TargetSdk 34: Elevated targetSdk to 34 and added FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE to eliminate FGS runtime exceptions on Android 14+.

🧹 Resource & Socket Leak Elimination: Wrapped all OkHttp response calls in .use { } across API services and updater, secured BroadcastReceiver coroutines with goAsync(), and added SSH session cleanup on TermuxService destruction.
